ValidationRule.description: Make the Vendor field mandatory if the type value is Internal - ADM/ACM
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(RecordType.DeveloperName = 'QIC_Service_request', ISPICKVAL(Type, 'Commercial Waiver (non BART)'), ISPICKVAL( Problem_Type__c , 'Internal - ADM/ACM'), ISBLANK(Text(Vendor__c)))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Vendor field is mandatory for Internal - ADM/ACM type
